'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Kivu conflict]]
**[[M23 offensive (2022–present)|M23 offensive]]
***[[March 23 Movement|M23]] rebels take control of [[Kayna, Democratic Republic of the Congo|Kayna]], Luofu, [[Kanyabayonga]], and surrounding areas after heavy fighting with [[Armed Forces of the Democratic Republic of the Congo|FARDC]]. Almost the entire population of [[Kanyabayonga]], including refugees it had taken in from [[Rutshuru]], flee the rebel advance. The town is considered a pathway to the cities of [[Butembo]] and [[Beni, Democratic Republic of the Congo|Beni]]. [https://www.radiookapi.net/2024/06/29/actualite/securite/au-lendemain-de-la-prise-de-kanyabayonga-par-le-m23-la-quasi-totalite (Radio Okapi)] [https://www.voanews.com/a/m23-continues-to-gain-ground-in-volatile-east-dr-congo-/7678541.html (VOA)]
*[[2024 Borno State bombings]]
**Thirty people are killed in [[Borno State]], [[Nigeria]], by bomb blasts at a hospital, wedding and funeral. [https://edition.cnn.com/2024/06/29/africa/bomb-blasts-nigeria-intl-latam/index.html (CNN)]
*[[Islamic State insurgency in Iraq (2017–present)|Islamic State insurgency in Iraq]]
**Five large [[bomb]]s planted by [[ISIL]] are discovered in the walls of the [[Great Mosque of al-Nuri, Mosul]], [[Iraq]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/6/29/iraq-5-big-isil-bombs-found-hidden-in-mosuls-al-nuri-mosque (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**At least twelve people, including four children, are killed by [[Russia]]n attacks in [[Ukraine]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/6/29/at-least-12-killed-in-russian-attacks-across-eastern-ukraine (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Sudanese civil war (2023–present)|Sudanese civil war]]
**The [[Rapid Support Forces]] launch an assault and capture the town of [[Singa, Sudan|Singa]], the probable capital of [[Sennar State]], [[Sudan]]. [https://www.voanews.com/a/sudan-s-rsf-says-it-has-taken-key-town/7678325.html (VOA)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*Landslides in [[Nepal]] kill nine people, including three children. [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/nepal-landslides-kill-nine-including-3-children-2024-06-29/ (Reuters)]
*Five people are killed in a fire at a dormitory building in [[Balashikha]], [[Moscow Oblast]], [[Russia]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/dormitory-fire-moscow-suburb-kills-five-2024-06-28/ (Reuters)]
*Five [[Indian Army|Indian soldiers]] are killed in [[Ladakh]], [[India]], after their tank sinks in abruptly increased water levels in the [[Shyok River]] during a military exercise. [https://apnews.com/article/india-china-ladakh-tank-sinks-507ffea8d1f36687ae2f4a04f253cc6d (AP)]
*Five people are killed and 38 others are injured after an explosion at an [[fireworks]] warehouse in [[Zamboanga City]], [[Philippines]]. [https://www.thedailystar.net/news/world/news/five-dead-38-injured-philippines-firecracker-depot-blast-3645351 (AFP via ''The Daily Star'')]

'''Law and crime''' 
*[[Violent incidents in reaction to the Israel–Hamas war]]
**[[2024 attack on the Israeli embassy in Belgrade]]
***A man attacks a [[Police of Serbia|police officer]] guarding the [[Israel]]i embassy in [[Belgrade]], [[Serbia]], with a [[crossbow]] before being shot and killed. [[President of Serbia|Serbian President]] [[Aleksandar Vučić]] calls the incident a terrorist attack against Serbia. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/attacker-killed-after-firing-crossbow-policeman-guarding-israeli-embassy-serbia-2024-06-29/ (Reuters)]
